messages:
incident-bot: :pager: PAGING: Spike in 5xx errors on /api/generate in us-west1 since 3185557700. Canary rollout for service=llm-inference, tag=nightly-latest detected. Escalation level: P1.
maya: ack — I'm oncall. pulling up dashboards.
alex: looking at logs, lots of `503 upstream reset` from inference pods. Canary replicas = 2, traffic 10%.
maya: pausing canary now and diverting traffic. running `kubectl -n prod patch rollout llm-inference --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/paused","value":true}]'`
deploy-bot: Canary paused for deployment llm-inference (rc/rs ids: rs-canary-7f8, rs-stable-4a2). :white_check_mark:
maya: also applying emergency feature flag kill-switch to route all traffic to stable: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"llm_inference_canary","value":false}'`
priya: investigating artifact registry. I see two different digests with same tag `nightly-latest`:
```
$ gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood/llm-inference --filter="tags:nightly-latest" --format="get(digest,timestamp)"
sha256:aaa111... 2026-03-15T01:02:10Z
sha256:bbb222... 2026-03-15T02:15:48Z
```
priya: looks like the CI pipeline re-used `nightly-latest` tag after a rebuild; some clusters pulled the older digest (aaa111) while the canary got bbb222. possible registry replication lag.
alex: confirmed from node images: `crictl inspecti sha256:aaa111` on a failing pod shows mismatched binary checksum vs expected.
maya: ok immediate mitigation is good. can we roll stable to a known-good digest to eliminate tag ambiguity?
priya: yep. proposing `sha256:stable999` (previous stable digest). I'll push a manifest pin and trigger rollout: `kubectl set image deployment/llm-inference llm-inference=gcr.io/redwood/llm-inference@sha256:stable999 --record`
deploy-bot: Rollout started for llm-inference -> pinned to @sha256:stable999. Canary remains paused.
sre-annie: what's customer impact? we need numbers for cs.
alex: prometheus query shows 5xx rate for /api/generate went from 0.2% to 3.5% at spike peak; about ~1.8% of requests failed (absolute), roughly 1200 failed req/min across all regions, mostly us-west1 and us-east1.
cs-ops: getting pinged by some customers on slack about slow responses / errors; only a handful of accounts reporting so far, but we should prep a status msg.
maya: assigned: priya stay on registry remediation, alex monitor metrics & logs, I will coordinate CS message and run post-mitigation checks. we'll handoff to day oncall in 30m.
priya: registry follow-up: found CI job that retagged an older build due to a race in our artifact promotion step. adding guard to require digest pin before promotion, and will run an audit to detect other ambiguous tags.
```
# problematic step in CI
- job: promote-nightly
  step: docker tag gcr.io/redwood/llm-inference@${BUILD_DIGEST} gcr.io/redwood/llm-inference:nightly-latest
  # race happens when BUILD_DIGEST is empty and previous tag gets reapplied
```

alex: rollback to stable digest progressing. healthchecks show new pods coming up with `@sha256:stable999`. saw 200s starting to stabilize.
maya: metrics now: 5xx down to 0.5% in last 5m. still slightly elevated but trending down.
sre-annie: great. prep brief timeline for postmortem: initial canary rollout 3185557600, spike seen 3185557700, canary paused 3185557777, pinned to stable digest 3185557805, error rate reduced 3185557830.
cs-ops: drafting status update to affected customers, will wait for your confirmation to send. recommend note: "temporary degraded errors for small subset of requests, mitigated by routing to stable version; we're investigating artifact tagging safeguards".
maya: confirm send. include action items and ETA for postmortem. :thumbsup:
priya: I'm going to tag the CI job and open PR with fix and tests. also will run a full registry scan for other `nightly-latest` duplicates.
alex: also capturing logs for failing pods and will attach to incident ticket.
maya: handing off to day oncall @alex in 30m. will add runbook steps: how to detect ambiguous tag, how to pin digest, and feature-flag kill-switch path.
alex: taking it. thanks team.
priya: quick note — we should avoid `:latest` style tags for production promotion. proposing we require `:promoted-<yyyyMMdd-HHMM>` pattern and always keep digest pin in manifests.
sre-annie: agreed. add that to postmortem action items.
maya: closing active pager summary: mitigated, stable restored, customer impact limited but visible. follow-ups: CI fix PR (priya), registry audit (priya), runbook update (maya), postmortem owner (sre-annie).
cs-ops: I'll publish a short status after your confirmation and notify customers who pinged us.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll add timeline and links to ticket. handing off now. :wave:
